description: Documents a host hands a run to retain (ContextInput.documents), which search scopes as attachments (agent#5): a text, read by line; a processed document, by page or line; and an image, read whole. The Desk hands its research runs documents in this shape today (web/src/research/useResearchRun.ts); the image is this harness's.
